comment: A patch can take a field out (wave 017, run 0126, issue #94): `REMOVE` with a `field`. FieldRemovalCasesTest.java (command line) and field-removal.test.js (editor) read this file, so that the two tools give the same model and the same table. `files`: a path from the folder of the workspace -> the text of the file (the manifests are below `manifests/`; `lean` and its siblings override baseline, a plateau with `override` stands on that one). `resolved`: the value a field of an element has in a plateau (`null`: the element has no such field). `comparisons`: `diff --plateau <plateau> --against <against>` in the command line, the plateau drawn and compared with the other one in the editor; `rows`: the rows of the table that are elements, as `layer|reference|change|natures` (the natures sorted, joined with a comma).

cases.what: a plateau takes an inherited description out; the plateau over it does not have it either, and the plateau below keeps it

files.manifests/base/shop.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/system"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "shop"
  name: "Shop"
  description: "Sells things."
  elements:
    - kind: "container"
      id: "web"
      name: "Web"
      description: "The storefront."
    - kind: "container"
      id: "api"
      name: "API"
      description: "The API."
      tags:
        tier: "gold"
files.manifests/base/tax.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/system"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "tax"
  name: "Tax"
  description: "Computes the tax."
files.manifests/base/prod.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/environment"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "prod"
  name: "Production"
  elements:
    - kind: "node"
      id: "vm"
      name: "VM"
      description: "The machine."
      applications: ["shop.web"]
files.manifests/lean/plateau.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/plateau"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "lean"
  patches:
    - operator: REMOVE
      target: shop
      field: description
files.manifests/leaner/plateau.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/plateau"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "leaner"
  override: "lean"
